audit_status.review_note: Reviewed as Esau/Edom genealogy with focus on names, Seir, chiefs, kings before Israelite monarchy, and Edom identity. Genealogical chapter kept lean by design.

verses.restored: These are the generations of Esau, that is, Edom.

familiar.text: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

notes.title: Esau/Edom
notes.body: The chapter explicitly identifies Esau with Edom and develops the Edomite line.

modern.text: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם

verses.restored: Esau took his women from the daughters of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

familiar.text: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan...

modern.text: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

original.text: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת נָשָׁ֖יו מִבְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת עָדָ֗ה בַּת אֵילוֹן֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י וְאֶת אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת עֲנָ֔ה בַּת צִבְע֖וֹן הַֽחִוִּֽי

verses.restored: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

familiar.text: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

modern.text: and Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

original.text: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲח֥וֹת נְבָיֽוֹת

verses.restored: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.

familiar.text: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

modern.text: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel,

original.text: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת רְעוּאֵֽל

verses.restored: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

familiar.text: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah...

modern.text: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

original.text: וְאָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת יעיש וְאֶת יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ ל֖וֹ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן

verses.restored: Esau took his women, his sons, his daughters, and all the persons of his house, his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions that he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went to a land away from Jacob his brother.

familiar.text: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters...

modern.text: Later, Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household, along with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the property he had acquired in Canaan, and he moved to a land far away from his brother Jacob.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת נָ֠שָׁיו וְאֶת בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת כָּל נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְאֶת מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת כָּל בְּהֶמְתּ֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ כָּל קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו

verses.restored: For their possessions were too many for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their livestock.

familiar.text: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together...

notes.title: Separation by abundance
notes.body: The separation echoes Abram and Lot: wealth creates spatial pressure.

modern.text: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.

original.text: כִּֽי הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Esau dwelled in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

familiar.text: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

modern.text: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir.

original.text: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם

verses.restored: These are the generations of Esau, father of Edom, in the hill country of Seir.

familiar.text: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites...

modern.text: This is the account of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in the area of Mount Seir.

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר

verses.restored: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Adah, Esau’s woman, and Reuel son of Basemath, Esau’s woman.

familiar.text: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz...

modern.text: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel son of Esau’s wife Basemath.

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו

verses.restored: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

familiar.text: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho...

modern.text: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

original.text: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אוֹמָ֔ר צְפ֥וֹ וְגַעְתָּ֖ם וּקְנַֽז

verses.restored: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These were the sons of Adah, Esau’s woman.

familiar.text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son...

modern.text: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek. These are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.

original.text: וְתִמְנַ֣ע הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽאֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן עֵשָׂ֔ו וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֶאֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו

verses.restored: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s woman.

familiar.text: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah...

modern.text: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.

original.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָזֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּמִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּ֣ה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו

verses.restored: These were the sons of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s woman: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

familiar.text: And these were the sons of Aholibamah...

modern.text: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah (daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon) whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

original.text: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אָהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת עֲנָ֛ה בַּת צִבְע֖וֹן אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת יעיש וְאֶת יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת קֹֽרַח

verses.restored: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz, firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

familiar.text: These were dukes of the sons of Esau...

notes.title: Chiefs
notes.body: Alluf means clan chief or leader, traditionally rendered duke in older English.

modern.text: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכ֣וֹר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אוֹמָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז

verses.restored: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

familiar.text: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek...

modern.text: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. They are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Adah.

original.text: אַלּֽוּף קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה

verses.restored: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s woman.

familiar.text: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son...

modern.text: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.

original.text: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֨חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו

verses.restored: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s woman: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs descended from Oholibamah daughter of Anah, Esau’s woman.

familiar.text: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife...

modern.text: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. They are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

original.text: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו

verses.restored: These are the sons of Esau, that is, Edom, and these are their chiefs.

familiar.text: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

modern.text: All these are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and they were their chiefs. The Descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1:38–42)

original.text: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם

verses.restored: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

familiar.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land...

modern.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

original.text: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי שֵׂעִיר֙ הַחֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֥וֹן וַעֲנָֽה

verses.restored: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.

familiar.text: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites...

modern.text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom.

original.text: וְדִשׁ֥וֹן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם

verses.restored: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Heman, and Lotan’s sister was Timna.

familiar.text: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam...

modern.text: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

original.text: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהֵימָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע

verses.restored: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

familiar.text: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan...

modern.text: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

original.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּמָנַ֖חַת וְעֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפ֖וֹ וְאוֹנָֽם

verses.restored: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

familiar.text: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah...

notes.title: Hot springs
notes.body: Yemim is difficult; hot springs is a common rendering, though other interpretations exist.

modern.text: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.)

original.text: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי צִבְע֖וֹן וְאַיָּ֣ה וַעֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת הַיֵּמִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּרְעֹת֥וֹ אֶת הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים לְצִבְע֥וֹן אָבִֽיו

verses.restored: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

familiar.text: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah...

modern.text: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

original.text: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת עֲנָֽה

verses.restored: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

familiar.text: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan...

modern.text: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

original.text: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן

verses.restored: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

familiar.text: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan...

modern.text: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן וַעֲקָֽן

verses.restored: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

familiar.text: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

modern.text: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

original.text: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן

verses.restored: These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

familiar.text: These are the dukes that came of the Horites...

modern.text: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַחֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לוֹטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שׁוֹבָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְע֖וֹן אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה

verses.restored: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

familiar.text: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan...

modern.text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their divisions in the land of Seir. The Kings of Edom (1 Chronicles 1:43–54)

original.text: אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר

verses.restored: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the sons of Israel.

familiar.text: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom...

notes.title: Before Israel's kings
notes.body: The narrator contrasts Edomite kingship with later Israelite monarchy.

modern.text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:

original.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

familiar.text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom...

modern.text: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.

original.text: וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּאֱד֔וֹם בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן בְּע֑וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה

verses.restored: Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.

familiar.text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned...

modern.text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה

verses.restored: Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

familiar.text: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned...

modern.text: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי

verses.restored: Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; the name of his city was Avith.

familiar.text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad...

modern.text: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.

original.text: וַיָּ֖מָת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עֲוִֽית

verses.restored: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

familiar.text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned...

modern.text: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה

verses.restored: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the River reigned in his place.

familiar.text: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned...

modern.text: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר

verses.restored: Shaul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.

familiar.text: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned...

modern.text: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.

original.text: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן עַכְבּֽוֹר

verses.restored: Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau, and the name of his woman was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.

familiar.text: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned...

modern.text: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

original.text: וַיָּמָת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר֒ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב

verses.restored: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families, according to their places, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

familiar.text: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau...

modern.text: These are the names of Esau’s chiefs, according to their families and regions, by their names: Chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

original.text: וְ֠אֵלֶּה שְׁמ֞וֹת אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לִמְקֹמֹתָ֖ם בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת

verses.restored: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

familiar.text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

modern.text: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

original.text: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן

verses.restored: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

familiar.text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

modern.text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

original.text: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר

verses.restored: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom according to their dwellings in the land of their possession. This is Esau, father of Edom.

familiar.text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom...

notes.title: Father of Edom
notes.body: The chapter closes as it began: Esau is father of Edom.

modern.text: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they possessed. Esau was the father of the Edomites.

original.text: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֗וֹם לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֽוֹם
